notes.text: Trevor van Riemsdyk is day to day (lower body injury) and has missed the last 11 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters. Spencer Stastney has taken his spot beside Kris Letang. That pair has had 67% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 60:11 together, up from 39% with van Riemsdyk.

Elmer Söderblom is out week to week (upper body injury) and has missed the last 4 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters. Nick Robertson has taken his spot beside Connor Dewar and Blake Lizotte. That line has had 58% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 36:00 together.

Bryan Rust is on injured reserve and has missed the last 6 games. Tommy Novak has taken his spot beside Sidney Crosby and Rickard Rakell. That line has had 58% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 66:42 together, up from 43% with Rust.
Ilya Solovyov has started killing penalties: on the ice for 43% of the team’s shorthanded time in 3 games, up from 5% last season.
Kevin Fiala is out week to week and has not played this season. He is one of their most valuable skaters.
Alex Turcotte has not dressed for the last 11 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Mats Zuccarello is on injured reserve (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 5 games.
Alex Turcotte is expected back after missing 11 games. Their recent numbers were built mostly without him.
Martin Chromiak was added to the roster on Oct 30 and has played beside Artemi Panarin and Alex Laferriere.
Kenny Connors was added to the roster on Nov 4 and has played beside Erik Haula and Joel Armia.

LAK.head: The Kings have a slight edge
LAK.body: Even though Los Angeles will be without Fiala, the Kings have been out-chancing opponents lately, have home-ice advantage and get Turcotte back. Still, it’s close: the Penguins can make it interesting if they keep the shots coming.

PIT.head: A slightly uphill night for the Penguins
PIT.body: Even though Los Angeles will be without Fiala, the Kings have been out-chancing opponents lately, have home-ice advantage and get Turcotte back. The Penguins’ best way to tip it is piling up shots.

story.head: Kuzmenko returns to Los Angeles
paras: The Kings (5-7-2) beat San Jose 7-2 on Wednesday, while the Penguins are winless in four (0-3-1). Both teams are near the bottom of the standings. Going in, the Penguins are seventh in the Metropolitan (tied for 28th in the NHL) and the Kings seventh in the Pacific (tied for 28th).

The Penguins have played better than their record (.375) says: their chances are worth about .560, mostly because they’re 3-6 in one-goal games. So have the Kings (.429 on chances worth .613), mostly because they’re 2-5 in one-goal games.

The Penguins sit back rather than chase on the forecheck (lowest), get more of their shots from in close than anyone (1st) and rarely throw hits (lowest). Pittsburgh has allowed 3.56 goals a game, the fourth most in the league. As for the Kings, they leave the shooting to their forwards (lowest) and lean hard on their top players (4th lowest). They also keep dangerous shots away better than almost anyone (3rd), so the Pens’ good looks will be harder to come by against them. That means the Penguins roll four lines, but the Kings lean on their top six.

Erik Karlsson (3 G / 13 A / 16 P in 16 GP) leads the Penguins in scoring, and Nick Robertson (7 G / 0 A / 7 P in 16 GP) has a team-high seven goals. The Kings’ scoring runs through Artemi Panarin (8 G / 9 A / 17 P in 14 GP), who has eight points in his last five games. Adrian Kempe (6 G / 6 A / 12 P in 13 GP) is next in line, with five goals in six games against Pittsburgh since 2023-24.
Sergei Murashov (0-4-1 / .871 SV% in 5 GS) is expected to start for Pittsburgh, and Darcy Kuemper (5-3-1 / .885 SV% in 9 GS) for Los Angeles.

items.text: The Penguins are newly without Andrei Kuzmenko, and have been without Trevor van Riemsdyk, Elmer Söderblom and Bryan Rust for several games.
The Kings have been without Mats Zuccarello since Oct 24, and have had to make do without Kevin Fiala all season.
Joel Edmundson is set to play his 700th NHL game.
Sidney Crosby has four goals in six games against Los Angeles since 2023-24.
